description: This file contains implementation of methods for translating GLSL to HLSL, specifically handling uniforms, interface blocks, and resource bindings in shader code. It defines the ResourcesHLSL class with functions for managing shader resource registers, outputting uniform and resource group declarations, and handling interface block structures.

classes.name: ResourcesHLSL
classes.description: Class managing shader resource bindings, uniforms, interface blocks, and resource group declarations for HLSL shaders.
